meta.name: Bottle detail ASK v7 — answerable, false-claim and no-data questions, internal and extracted profiles, 400 questions
meta.pass_rule: At least 90% of answers fully correct (grade 2), overall and in each category of 10 or more questions.
meta.notes: Held-out set. 200 on the internal profiles (100 answerable, 50 false claims, 25 questions about a detail the notes never hold, 25 about an invented grape that exists in neither source) and 200 on the extracted table (100 answerable, 50 false claims, 50 with a country that has no rows for the grape). Invented names were checked against the grape list, both knowledge sources, the reviews database and the wineries directory. Profiles and keys are evaluation metadata only, never passed to Gemma.
